newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-AUXERRE CAPTAIN LAMOUCHI OUT OF AJAX MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE CAPTAIN LAMOUCHI OUT OF AJAX MATCH.

text.p: France midfielder Sabri Lamouchi will miss Auxerre's European champions' league group A match away to Ajax Amsterdam next week because of an ankle injury.
The Auxerre captain was injured playing for France on October 9 but recovered to play in their home champions' league match against Grasshopper Zurich a week later.
But Lamouchi has since suffered problems with the injury and missed the away game against Grasshopper on October 30 and the home defeat by Metz in the league last week.
